title: Music

connect.title: Sources
connect.lastfmHint: Enter your Last.fm username and an API key: create one at last.fm/api/account/create (any app name, callback can be empty). The key is stored encrypted on the server.
connect.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect Last.fm? Already loaded history will stay.
connect.spotifyDescription: “Now playing” with cover art and progress
connect.spotifyNotConfigured: Not configured on the server: create an app at developer.spotify.com, add Redirect URI = PUBLIC_URL + /api/music/spotify/callback and set SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID / SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET in .env.
connect.spotifyHint: The Spotify sign-in page will open. Only access to the current track is requested.
connect.invalid: The service rejected the data — check the username and key
connect.error: Something went wrong. Please try later.

history.complete: The whole Last.fm history is here: {{count}} plays. New ones are added every 15 minutes.
history.running: Importing — you can close the page, it runs on the server.
history.paused: Imported in portions every 15 minutes. You can import the rest right away.

widget.empty: Connect Last.fm or Spotify in the Music section

noSource: No music source connected yet: connect Last.fm or Spotify to see history, statistics and tops.

lastfm.1: Sign up at last.fm and turn on scrobbling in what you listen with (for Spotify: last.fm → Settings → Applications → Spotify).
lastfm.2: Open last.fm/api/account/create: any application name, the other fields may stay empty; copy the API key.
lastfm.3: Type your Last.fm user name and the key here: the history is imported in the background.

spotify.1: Open developer.spotify.com/dashboard and create an app (any name).
spotify.2: As its Redirect URI, add the address of the dashboard plus /api/music/spotify/callback (Spotify does not accept localhost — use 127.0.0.1 locally).
spotify.3: Put the Client ID and the Client Secret into the server's .env as SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID and SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET and restart the dashboard.
spotify.4: Press “Connect” here and allow access in Spotify.
